# Hearth Insulation

> Owner-operated insulation contractor serving Indianapolis, IN and the
> surrounding metro since 2004. Blown-in attic insulation, batt insulation
> replacement, and insulation removal. Every free home evaluation includes a
> thermal imaging scan and a written fixed-price quote. All work is performed
> by in-house crews; no subcontractors. Tagline: "Comfort starts here."

Phone: (317) 555-0100
Email: hello@hearthinsulation.com
Owner: Paul Bryant (20+ years of building science experience)
Service area: Indianapolis, Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield,
Zionsville, Greenwood, Avon, Brownsburg, Lawrence, Beech Grove, and Geist.

Key facts: Indianapolis is in IECC Climate Zone 5. The U.S. Department of
Energy recommends attic insulation of R-49 to R-60 in this zone. Most local
homes Hearth evaluates have R-19 or less.

## Services

- [Blown-In Attic Insulation](https://www.hearthinsulation.com/services/blown-in-attic-insulation/): Loose-fill insulation blown to a verified depth, with air sealing first.
- [Batt Insulation Replacement](https://www.hearthinsulation.com/services/batt-insulation-replacement/): Failed, sagging, or contaminated batts replaced and installed to spec.
- [Insulation Removal](https://www.hearthinsulation.com/services/insulation-removal/): Contained vacuum removal of contaminated or wet insulation.
- [5-Step Attic Restoration Process](https://www.hearthinsulation.com/attic-insulation-process/): Removal, decontamination, air sealing, exterior sealing, blown-in install.
